mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cms_comment ( post_id, author, post_title, content, status, report_count, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{postId}, #{author}, #{postTitle}, #{content}, #{status}, #{reportCount}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.post_id, c.author, c.post_title, c.content, c.status, c.report_count, c.created_at, c.updated_at FROM cms_comment c WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.id DESC

SELECT c.id, c.post_id, c.author, c.post_title, c.content, c.status, c.report_count, c.created_at, c.updated_at FROM cms_comment c
c.status = #{status}
AND
( LOWER(c.author) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') OR LOWER(c.post_title) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') OR LOWER(c.content) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') )
AND c.report_count > 0
ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.id DESC
SELECT c.id, c.post_id, c.author, c.post_title, c.content, c.status, c.report_count, c.created_at, c.updated_at FROM cms_comment c WHERE c.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE cms_comment SET author = #{author}, post_title = #{postTitle}, content = #{content}, status = #{status}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE cms_comment SET status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
